items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s LATAM Marketing team helps people understand how AI can benefit their lives and put that value into practice. We connect global product innovation with local consumer needs, culture and behavior across Brazil and Spanish-speaking Latin America, contributing to OpenAI’s mission of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We bring together strategy and creativity across integrated campaigns, product launches, creators, social, partnerships and cultural experiences. Working with global and local cross-functional teams, we make AI’s everyday usefulness tangible and relevant to people across the region. About the Role We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Integrated Marketing Manager to lead consumer marketing programs across LATAM, with an immediate focus on Brazil and close collaboration across Spanish-speaking markets. This role is based in São Paulo, Brazil. You will turn consumer insight and product understanding into a clear strategy, a compelling creative idea and an integrated plan that delivers measurable results. You should be as comfortable exploring an AI product and writing a brief as aligning global stakeholders, guiding creative development and driving execution. Your work will help people discover useful applications of ChatGPT and build confidence in new capabilities. This role is based in Brazil; São Paulo, hybrid model. In this role, you will: - Build consumer strategies from research, market signals and local cultural insight, identifying the audience, unmet need and behavior each program should influence. - Translate product features, AI capabilities and real product behavior into clear consumer use cases, messaging and brand storytelling, with accurate expectations about capabilities and limitations. - Lead integrated campaigns from brief to launch and learning, giving paid, owned, earned, social, creators, partnerships and experiences distinct, complementary roles. - Adapt global launches and campaigns to local needs while protecting the core brand strategy; create locally originated ideas when the opportunity calls for them. - Connect cultural relevance with practical product utility, helping both existing users and new audiences move from discovery to trial, broader usage and repeat engagement. - Partner with creator, social and partnership teams to sustain product education between major launches and turn cultural moments into a consistent marketing presence. - Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Growth, Brand, Creative, Production, Comms, Data and Regional teams to align priorities, messaging, channel plans and launch readiness, including when timelines change quickly. - Define success and learning plans before launch, using relevant brand and behavioral metrics and experimentation where feasible. - Manage campaign resources, agencies, budgets and production dependencies within agreed authority; make clear trade-offs and build forward plans that account for creative lead times and local market conditions. What you bring - 12+ years of technology marketing experience across Brazil and Spanish-speaking LATAM, with a proven record of leading integrated B2C programs and hands-on experience marketing AI products. - Deep local market knowledge and an insight-first approach - Strong product marketing expertise and genuine product curiosity. You explore AI tools yourself and can turn complex capabilities into useful, credible consumer stories. - Strong strategic and creative judgment, connecting brand positioning, product value and distribution to a compelling central campaign idea. - Understanding of the full consumer journey and how marketing contributes to awareness, acquisition, activation, adoption, engagement, retention or monetization, depending on the objective. - Strong measurement and experimentation discipline, with the ability to distinguish activity and platform metrics from business impact and explain attribution limits. - Experience balancing regional consistency with local nuance, and influencing cross-functional and global teams without relying on formal authority. - A clear record of personal ownership: you can set direction, produce high-quality work directly, manage agencies and delivery, and make progress with incomplete inputs and limited resources. - Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish, with the ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across local, regional and global teams. Nice to have - An established network of local creative, media, creator or cultural partners, and experience reaching audiences beyond the region’s largest urban centers. - Experience connecting consumer product adoption with professional use cases, or building reusable launch and campaign practices across markets. items.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer, pAGI
items.description: About the Team pAGI Infra team builds and operates the systems that make large-scale model training and evaluation reliable, efficient, and easy to run. Our work spans distributed training infrastructure, inference and grading platforms, compute scheduling, and research tooling. We partner closely with researchers and engineering teams to turn new research needs into dependable infrastructure, improve GPU efficiency, and shorten the path from an experiment to a validated model. About the Role We’re looking for an AI Systems Engineer to help scale the infrastructure behind our training and evaluation workflows. You’ll own projects from identifying bottlenecks and designing solutions through deployment and operation. The work combines distributed systems engineering, performance optimization, and close collaboration with researchers. You might build a shared grading service, improve resource allocation across workloads, or bring a new training stack into production — directly improving how quickly and reliably research moves forward. In this role, you will: - Build and operate infrastructure for large-scale training and evaluation, improving reliability, throughput, and resource efficiency. - Develop shared inference and grading platforms with automated capacity management, health monitoring, and visibility into performance. - Improve compute scheduling and resource allocation to reduce idle GPU time and help workloads recover quickly from failures. - Diagnose bottlenecks across training, inference, and orchestration, and work across teams to improve end-to-end performance. - Build self-service tools, automated validation, and observability that help researchers launch experiments, diagnose issues, and compare results with less manual intervention. You might thrive in this role if you: - Are excited about the potential of personal AGI and want to build the infrastructure that enables it. - Have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building or operating large-scale distributed systems. - Have experience in ML infrastructure, inference systems, GPU performance, or infrastructure tooling. - Are highly self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership of open-ended problems. - Enjoy debugging across system boundaries and using measurements to guide improvements in performance and reliability. items.title: Software Engineer, Ads Integrity
items.description: About the Team The Integrity team builds the systems that protect OpenAI’s products, users, and ecosystem from abuse. We work across product engineering, infrastructure, safety, and operations to detect and prevent harmful, fraudulent, deceptive, and adversarial activity at global scale. As OpenAI builds new ads experiences, we are establishing the integrity foundation that will keep the ads ecosystem safe and trustworthy from the start. This includes protecting advertiser onboarding, detecting unsafe or policy-violating ad content, preventing fraudulent and abusive advertiser behavior, and defending the ads ecosystem against spam, manipulation, and other forms of abuse. Ads Integrity is a new and highly cross-functional area. The team partners closely with Ads, Product, Safety, Policy, ML, Privacy, Security, and operations teams to build protections directly into the ads platform rather than layering them on after the fact. This is an opportunity to define how integrity works for a new ads ecosystem from first principles. About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer to build the backend systems and infrastructure that keep OpenAI’s ads products safe, trustworthy, and resilient to abuse. In this foundational role, you will design systems that detect, prevent, and respond to harmful, deceptive, fraudulent, or policy-violating activity across the ads lifecycle. The problems span advertiser onboarding and verification, account and behavioral risk, content safety, spam and fraudulent interactions, detection and enforcement infrastructure, and the systems that connect integrity signals and models to real-time product decisions. This is not an ML-specialist role, but familiarity with ML for Ads integrity is always welcome. You’ll work closely with ML engineers and researchers and build systems that consume and operationalize ML-based signals, but your primary focus will be designing and operating robust backend and distributed systems. You’ll help determine how signals, rules, models, and human review come together into reliable integrity protections for advertisements that can operate at OpenAI scale. This role is particularly well suited to an engineer who has built large-scale systems in integrity, trust and safety, anti-abuse, fraud, risk, security, or a related adversarial domain. You will have significant ownership over what we build and how we build it, partnering across Integrity and Ads to establish the architecture and technical foundations that will protect OpenAI’s ads ecosystem as it grows. This role is based in San Francisco. We offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Design and build large-scale backend systems that detect and prevent harmful, deceptive, fraudulent, or policy-violating activity across the ads ecosystem. - Build low-latency integrity infrastructure capable of evaluating risk signals and making decisions in or near real time. - Develop scalable risk-signal pipelines, decision systems, rules and enforcement infrastructure across the advertiser and ads lifecycle. - Build advertiser onboarding, business verification, account-risk, fraud-detection, and abuse-prevention capabilities that make it harder for malicious actors to enter or exploit the ecosystem. - Develop systems that support ads-specific content safety and enable the detection and enforcement of unsafe, misleading, deceptive, or policy-violating ads. - Build protections against spam, fraudulent interactions, manipulation, and other adversarial behaviors that threaten the health of the ads ecosystem. - Partner with ML teams to integrate classifiers and model-based signals into production integrity systems, including both lightweight real-time protections and more sophisticated asynchronous detection. - Build feedback loops, review systems, and integrity metrics that improve detection quality while carefully managing false positives and impact on legitimate advertisers and users. - Create tooling and infrastructure that enable operations and policy teams to investigate abuse and make fast, consistent, and explainable decisions. - Engineer systems that adapt as adversaries change their tactics and support effective experimentation, monitoring, and incident response. - Partner closely with Ads Engineering to integrate integrity protections throughout the ads platform without compromising reliability, latency, or product quality. - Help define the technical strategy and architecture for Ads Integrity as both the product and underlying threat landscape evolve. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have significant experience building and operating large-scale backend or distributed systems. - Have worked on integrity, trust and safety, anti-abuse, fraud, risk, security, business verification, or another domain where systems must operate against sophisticated or evolving adversaries. - Have built detection, decisioning, enforcement, verification, investigation, or risk infrastructure in production. - Understand how rules, heuristics, risk signals, ML-based signals, and human review can work together within a dependable production system. - Are comfortable building ML-adjacent infrastructure and partnering closely with ML teams without needing to be an ML domain expert. - Have built low-latency, high-throughput services or data pipelines with demanding reliability, correctness, privacy, and security requirements. - Can reason about false positives, adversarial behavior, explainability, auditability, and the operational impact of automated enforcement. - Think holistically about threat models, system architecture, data quality, observability, user impact, and ecosystem health. - Can define technical direction in an ambiguous 0→1 environment and independently drive complex work across teams. - Communicate clearly and work effectively across engineering, product, policy, safety, security, operations, and machine-learning teams. - Have experience with ads, ads integrity, advertiser systems, or ads fraud. This is a plus, but not a requirement. - Are excited to build the integrity foundation for a new product area rather than inherit a mature system. items.description: About the Team The mission of the Applied AI Engineering team is to enable the secure and impactful implementation of Agentic solutions. In this international Government role, you will deliver clearly scoped AI use cases with public-sector customers, from a mission need through hands-on implementation, architecture, evaluations, measurable adoption, and documented handoff. Account-aligned technical and commercial owners retain ongoing account ownership. About the Role We are looking for a driven solutions leader with a product mindset to partner with our international public-sector customers and ensure they achieve tangible value with GenAI. You will pair with government agencies, policymakers, and other public institutions to establish a GenAI strategy and identify the highest value applications. You’ll partner with their technical teams, subject matter experts, regional cloud providers, systems integrators, and implementation partners to move from prototype through production. You’ll design architectures using supported OpenAI technologies and approved services, with explicit data, inference, evaluation, and production-readiness boundaries. You will collaborate closely with regional Sales and Solutions Engineering, Global Affairs, Applied Research, Product, Legal, and Security teams. This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Deliver clearly scoped technical implementations with sophisticated international public-sector customers, serving as their hands-on engineering partner to build applications on supported model APIs, Codex, and other approved OpenAI technologies. - Work with senior customer stakeholders to identify the best applications of GenAI in their industry and to build/qualify a comprehensive backlog to support their AI roadmap. - Intervene directly to accelerate customer time to value through building hands-on prototypes and/or by delivering impactful strategic guidance, often in collaboration with systems integrators and implementation partners. - Forge and manage relationships with our customers’ and implementation partners’ leadership and stakeholders to ensure the successful deployment and scale of their applications. - Contribute to our open-source developer and enterprise resources. - Scale the Applied AI Engineering function through sharing knowledge, codifying best practices, and publishing notebooks to our internal and external repositories. - Validate, synthesize, and deliver high-signal feedback to the Product, Engineering, and Research teams. You will thrive in this role if you: - Bring substantial technical consulting or hands-on delivery experience with international public-sector or similarly regulated customers, bridging regional technical teams and senior stakeholders. - Have successfully led GenAI or traditional ML implementations for government agencies in close collaboration with systems integrators and implementation partners. - Understand network and cloud architecture, including on-premise deployments, and show practical judgment about privacy, data residency, model-inference location, sovereign or regulated environments, identity, procurement, and customer authorization. - Are an effective and polished communicator who can translate business and technical topics to all audiences, including cross-cultural communication with public-sector executives, regional delivery partners, and legal/security stakeholders. - Have industry experience in programming languages like Python, Go, or Typescript. - Own problems end-to-end and are willing to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to get the job done. - Have a humble attitude, an eagerness to help your colleagues, and a desire to do whatever it takes to make the team succeed. - Are an effective, high throughput operator who can drive multiple concurrent projects and prioritize ruthlessly. - Can work with stakeholders in the target region's business hours and travel when required for customer delivery. - Existing UK Developed Vetting (DV) clearance is strongly preferred, particularly for work with UK intelligence and defense customers. items.title: Fraud Investigator - Customer Protection
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Fraud Investigator (Customer Protection Team) is responsible for handling inbound customer calls for customers with an active fraud alert and account restriction. The team investigates fraud alerts, determining fraud or no fraud utilizing tools and investigative skills, and helping identify emerging fraud trends through data analysis. The team works directly with the customer via phone to gather additional information to help make a fraud determination on their account. This role is based in our Lake Mary, Florida or Denver, CO office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. Hours may vary from Monday through Friday between the hours of 7am to 9pm ET. . At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Conduct in-depth and timely investigations on accounts flagged for fraud, across a range of payment vehicles including ACH, Debit Card, Cryptocurrency and Wire Transfers Handling inbound phone calls from users with fraud restrictions and taking those fraud cases to the finish line by applying investigative techniques according to the internal procedures and policies Using critical thinking and pattern detection to discover proactive ways to identify emerging fraud Documenting the rationale and determination for each alert and referring to other teams where necessary Gathering key information from the customer regarding their account as well as applicable documentation. Communicating with customers next steps and setting expectations. What you bring 2+ years experience in fraud investigations including in-depth knowledge of various fraud activities such as Account Takeovers, Identity Theft, Money Mule, and Money Movement Fraud, among others; or, equivalent experience adjacent to fraud investigations. Proactively identify problems and come up with solutions (ability to think outside-the-box) Ability to operate in a fast paced environment Good written and verbal communication, analytical skills, and strong attention to detail Strong interpersonal skills, experience working with cross-functional teams such as product, engineering, legal, compliance, vendor partners, or financial crimes Passionate about mentoring and working with junior fraud investigators and agents to help guide and explore career Ability to work closely with customers to address concerns related to fraud while maintaining a high level of customer service Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) certification not required but a plus What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + benefits. items.title: Technical Program Manager, Science Operations, Code
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to partner with Mistral's code and vibe research team - the researchers shaping how our models write, reason about, and play with code. You'll be their operational counterpart - the person who absorbs what the team is working on and makes it legible to the team, to leadership, and to adjacent teams. This isn't a coordination role. It's a research partnership role - embedded with the team, fluent in what they're building, and operationally responsible for everything that isn't the science itself. The ideal candidate is someone who is genuinely excited about code models. You play with them. You have opinions about what makes them feel good to use. You read the papers because you want to, not because you have to. A research background is a plus but not required - what matters is that you care about this domain and can hold your own in a room full of researchers working on it. WHAT WILL YOU DO - Research Visibility: Partner with the team to maintain a shared, accessible view of their ongoing work - what's in flight, where it's heading, what's ready to hand off. Make the research legible to adjacent teams and leadership without pulling researchers into status work. - Operational Partnership: Be the team's operational partner. Handle the coordination, resourcing, and cross-team conversations that would otherwise sit on researchers' plates - so the team can stay focused on the science. - Research-to-release: Own the operational path from research work to release candidate for code and vibe workstreams. Partner with the release function to ensure the team's work flows cleanly into Mistral's release machinery. - Visibility & Communication Cadence: Code and vibe research connects to many other efforts across the organization. Keep these interfaces clean and high-signal, so the team's work integrates naturally with the wider science org. - Strategic Communication: Translate the team's work into clear, well-timed updates for leadership and adjacent teams - what's being built, what matters, what's coming next. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Genuine enthusiasm for code models and coding assistants - you play with them, push them, have opinions about them - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience - 3+ years of experience in technical program management, operations, or research coordination - Strong analytical skills; comfortable working in ambiguity and shaping it into structure - Ability to engage substantively with research work and build real credibility with technical teams - Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate technical detail into clarity for different audiences Nice to have criteria/ would be ideal if you have/are: - Experience in research-heavy or ML/AI organizations - Familiarity with code generation, coding agents, software engineering benchmarks, or related research areas - Hands-on experience with modern coding tools - you're a user, not just an observer - Track record of building systemic processes from the ground up - Comfort working in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments where priorities shift quickly WHY JOIN US? - Shape how frontier AI is built and released: You’ll design and operate the systems that connect scientific discovery to real-world deployment - ensuring our work scales with clarity, reliability, and speed - Work inside the Science OS: Join a team building the operational backbone of Mistral’s science organization - where structure meets creativity and processes evolve through use, not bureaucracy - Drive visible, high-leverage impact: Your work will sit at the intersection of research, engineering, and leadership - turning complexity into alignment and enabling confident, data-informed decisions across the company WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Software Engineer, Security Agents
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ROLE OVERVIEW Ready to build AI agents that revolutionize enterprise security? The North Security team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to create autonomous systems that handle the complex, critical tasks security practitioners face every day. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES As a Senior Software Engineer focused on agentic security, you'll build intelligent systems that empower security teams. Your responsibilities will include: - Build autonomous security agents that perform alert triage, secure code reviews, threat modeling, and vulnerability assessment - Develop agent orchestration systems that help security practitioners automate repetitive security tasks - Design and implement agent security controls to ensure our AI agents can safely interact with sensitive enterprise data - Create the security infrastructure that allows agents to operate in high-trust environments with stringent deployment requirements - Ship production-ready agent capabilities that run efficiently in resource-constrained environments - Research and implement novel security patterns for AI agent systems, sometimes requiring custom solutions where standard libraries fall short - Conduct security testing of both the agents you build and the platform that runs them. QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping user-facing security features - Strong Python development skills with significant production experience - Experience building or working with autonomous systems, AI agents, or intelligent automation - Solid understanding of security principles including session management, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices - Ability to think about security at multiple layers: application security, agent behavior security, and infrastructure security - Comfortable working across the full stack and diving into unfamiliar codebases to understand and fix issues - Thrive in fast-paced environments where you can adapt to evolving priorities - Excited about the intersection of AI/ML and security engineering. WORKING LOCATION This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Krak is Kraken's consumer banking and payments product — a fast-moving team building the card, payments, and financial features that bring crypto to everyday life. The Krak Product Operations team sits at the heart of this, making sure the business can move quickly without getting blindsided by compliance, risk, vendor, or operational dependencies. This is one of two roles in Krak’s Product Ops function, reporting to the Manager, Product Ops - Krak. You'll bring leadership to the day-to-day, working directly with compliance, legal, fraud, client engagement (CE), and external vendors to make sure new features land safely and successfully. THE OPPORTUNITY Product Ops at Krak is a co-ordination and intelligence function. Your job is to make sure that the cross-functional dependencies that could slow or derail delivery are surfaced early, actively managed, and resolved. You'll also help the team make better product decisions by curating the right operational data and bringing market and vendor intelligence into the room. You'll work across four areas: compliance and risk co-ordination, third party vendor management, responding to management information (MI) and feature performance, and strategic market intelligence. Your job is to make sure the right conversations happen at the right time, and that nothing falls through the cracks on the way to launch. Compliance & risk co-ordination - Maintain live, product-specific trackers of open compliance and legal items, including DRIs, status, and upcoming milestones - Triage new features against regulatory requirements ahead of development; ensure sign-off is built into delivery milestones - Work closely with fraud leads to ensure fraud controls and risk/velocity rules are factored into feature design (card, third party payments, and others) - Ensure fraud and CE teams are operationally positioned - with the right tooling, admin access, battlecards, and support articles - ahead of new product and feature launches - Support incident response for product-related issues and ensure post-incident reviews feed into product changes Third party vendor management - Maintain product-specific vendor trackers covering status, open actions, key contacts, and upcoming milestones - Own the cadence for performance reviews with key vendors and track actions to closure - Maintain a working view of vendor roadmaps and capabilities; produce periodic briefings on where vendor developments create product opportunities or constraints Responding to MI & feature performance - Ensure experiments and feature launches are supported by readily available fraud, dispute, and CE metrics alongside commercial KPIs - Interpret fraud, dispute, CE, and auth/decline data to identify emerging issues and surface them to the right teams - Drive follow-through on cross-functional findings - whether that's a compliance flag or a vendor issue Strategic market intelligence - Scan the market for competitors' changes to features, pricing, and risk positioning - Monitor regulatory and market developments that could affect the Krak roadmap - Identify third party vendor capabilities that could enable features not yet on the roadmap; flag where the current stack may be a constraint WHAT YOU BRING - 3-5 years experience in a product operations, strategy, or programme management role in a consumer fintech, payments, or banking business - ideally at a company with a card or payments product - Strong working knowledge of the regulatory and compliance landscape for consumer financial products in one of more regions - Experience working alongside or within fraud and risk functions; understanding of how fraud controls interact with product design - Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams with different stakeholders and different cadences, without dropping the ball - Track record of turning complex operational data into clear, actionable MI for product and leadership teams - Structured thinker who's comfortable in the detail but can step back and see the bigger picture - Strong communicator - able to translate between the worlds of compliance, risk, engineering, and product NICE TO HAVES - Experience with card issuing programmes (scheme rules, chargeback processes, fraud typologies) - Familiarity with third party banking and payments vendors (e.g. BIN sponsors, scheme processors, TPP aggregators) - Prior experience in a fast-scaling consumer fintech or neobank - Exposure to crypto or digital assets products Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. Our FDEs engage with customers to accelerate the adoption of existing products and create new applications built on our models. Working closely with our Post-Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll combine engineering expertise, an understanding of frontier AI applications, and customer-facing skills to understand customer workflows and develop innovative solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability. You will sit at the frontier of enterprise AI deployments and serve as one of our founding FDEs who helps to shape our forward-deployed motion. We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive under ambiguity, and represent Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. This is a significant responsibility: you’ll play a key role in championing our mission in the enterprise. Responsibilities Work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, ensuring that these products meet customer requirements. Deliver technical artifacts for customers like MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills that will be used in production workflows. Provide white glove deployment support for Anthropic products in enterprise environments. Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams. Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks. Build long term relationships with customers and proactively identify new opportunities for AI deployment throughout the lifecycle of an engagement. Travel frequently (25-50%) to customer sites to build in person with customers. Be a champion for Anthropic’s mission in the field. You May Be a Good Fit If You Have 4+ years of experience in a technical, customer facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, or as a Software Engineer with consulting or product experience. Former technical founders are also encouraged to apply. Production experience with LLMs including advanced prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale. Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python (and ideally in one or more additional languages like TypeScript, Java, etc) and experience shipping production applications High agency with an ability to navigate ambiguity present in complex organizations. High cooperation mindset for cross-organizational collaboration, balancing competing priorities with integrity. Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI systems through creative technical applications. Strong communication skills to conduct discovery with customers and to convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders while maintaining a low ego and collaborative approach. A background in financial services, healthcare/life sciences, or another enterprise vertical is a plus. Experience with enterprise IT systems and/or AI deployment patterns is a plus. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £225,000 — £255,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. items.title: B2B Marketing Manager, DACH
items.description: About the Team Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption. The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership. DACH is one of OpenAI’s most important markets in EMEA. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI. About the Role As the B2B Marketing Manager for DACH, you will own the integrated B2B marketing strategy and execution for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption. You will carry clear pipeline goals and be accountable for Marketing’s measurable contribution to commercial outcomes in DACH. These goals will be established through the regional planning process and will evolve with the priorities and maturity of the market. You will be expected to understand the pipeline, make informed investment decisions, and demonstrate how marketing activity creates, influences, or accelerates revenue opportunities. This is a generalist role spanning field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based programs, content, customer marketing, partnerships, events, and product launches. You will bring these channels together into a focused DACH B2B plan, drawing on specialist capabilities within the EMEA B2B Marketing team in London and global Marketing teams. A particularly important partnership will be with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead: together, you will align market strategy, narratives, launches, audience priorities, channels, and major moments so B2B and B2C activity is coordinated, complementary, and mutually reinforcing. Close partnership with Marketing Operations will be crucial. Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next. The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed. This role is preferably based in Munich. Berlin may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Regular travel within DACH and to London will be required. In this role, you will: - Own and execute the integrated DACH B2B marketing plan, aligned with regional priorities, local revenue goals, market opportunities, and customer needs. Partner closely with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead to ensure B2B and B2C strategies and activities are coordinated and complementary, while retaining clear accountability for B2B pipeline and revenue outcomes. - Carry pipeline goals for DACH B2B marketing and be accountable for demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline creation, influence, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes. - Partner closely with DACH Sales and GTM leadership on territory planning, target-account prioritisation, pipeline goals, strategic opportunities, and quarterly business reviews. - Build full-funnel programs across field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, content, customer advocacy, partnerships, events, and digital channels. - Design programs around priority accounts and buying groups, tailoring narratives and engagement for senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—and connecting customer proof, partner participation, content, and seller follow-up to create or advance opportunities. - Work in close partnership with Marketing Operations to define target audiences, establish campaigns, maintain data and process quality, track performance, improve attribution, and turn results into clear recommendations. - Build a regular Sales, Marketing, and Marketing Operations pacing rhythm covering pipeline performance, account engagement, campaign conversion, opportunity follow-up, risks, and investment decisions. - Translate global campaigns, product launches, narratives, and assets into locally relevant programs that reflect DACH market dynamics, language, industry priorities, and customer expectations. - Work with EMEA specialist teams in London to bring the strongest regional capabilities into the market, while serving as the voice of DACH in regional planning and prioritisation. - Develop locally relevant customer stories and advocacy opportunities in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Comms, and senior customer stakeholders. - Build joint programs with strategic technology, consulting, and implementation partners where they can extend reach, strengthen customer value, or contribute to pipeline. - Own the operating rhythm for DACH B2B marketing, including planning, budget management, agency coordination, campaign pacing, performance reporting, and prioritisation. - Build repeatable playbooks and share market learning across EMEA, helping the wider organisation understand what resonates with DACH customers and decision-makers. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 12+ years of experience in integrated B2B, regional, field, demand generation, or account-based marketing, ideally in enterprise technology, cloud, AI, or SaaS. - Have a proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through integrated B2B marketing programs, ideally within large, complex enterprise sales cycles. - Have supported high-value products with long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and significant commercial scrutiny, and are familiar with engaging senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—throughout complex buying journeys. - Have held pipeline goals or comparable commercial targets and can clearly demonstrate how your marketing decisions created, influenced, or accelerated revenue opportunities. - Have partnered closely with enterprise sellers and Sales leadership on account prioritisation, pipeline reviews, opportunity acceleration, executive engagement, and follow-up. - Have worked closely with Marketing Operations on campaign architecture, segmentation, lead and account processes, measurement, attribution, and performance reporting. - Are comfortable using pipeline and campaign data to diagnose performance, make trade-offs, and redirect investment—not simply report activity. - Are a marketing generalist with experience connecting multiple channels into one coherent market plan, rather than operating within a single specialist discipline, and have a strong track record of partnering with consumer marketing leaders to integrate B2B and B2C strategy and activity without blurring ownership. - Understand DACH enterprise buying dynamics and can translate local customer, industry, cultural, and regulatory context into stronger marketing decisions. - Can balance local market needs with regional and global priorities, influencing effectively within a matrixed international organisation. - Are both strategic and hands-on: able to establish direction and operating structure while personally driving high-priority work to completion. - Bring strong commercial judgement, operational discipline, and the ability to make clear prioritisation decisions when opportunities exceed available capacity. - Communicate credibly with senior customer decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—as well as Sales, Marketing, and partner stakeholders. - Are energised by AI and motivated to help organisations across DACH adopt transformative technology responsibly. - Are fluent in German and English. items.title: Doctorant·e CIFRE Data Science Personnalisation et Jeu Responsable F/H
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic est un acteur européen majeur du pari sportif et du jeu en ligne, proposant des activités de paris sportifs, de poker, de courses hippiques et de casino sur plusieurs marchés. Notre mission est de faire grandir la passion du sport et du jeu en proposant une expérience de divertissement innovante, dans un environnement sécurisé et responsable. Avec environ 1 600 collaborateurs répartis dans cinq pays et un siège basé à Bordeaux, Betclic est une entreprise internationale, moderne et profondément technologique. Chez Betclic, la Data n’est pas une fonction support : des dizaines de modèles et de produits data tournent en production et contribuent directement à l’expérience de millions de joueurs. Vous rejoindrez une équipe Data Science de plus de dix personnes, dont quatre docteurs, qui travaille au quotidien avec les équipes Produit, Engineering, MLOps et Jeu Responsable. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 Cette opportunité combine un programme de recherche ambitieux avec un environnement industriel concret : • Une thèse CIFRE de 3 ans avec un CDI dès l’embauche • Un sujet de recherche directement lié au jeu responsable et à des décisions produit concrètes • Des données comportementales et transactionnelles à grande échelle, des systèmes de recommandation en production et un environnement d’expérimentation • Un environnement international et créatif dans lequel la Data Science a un impact visible • Un accès à Claude et une culture encourageant l’usage responsable de l’IA générative pour la recherche, le prototypage, l’analyse et la rédaction ENTER THE GAME 🎮 En tant que doctorant·e CIFRE, vous rejoindrez l’équipe Data Science de Betclic et travaillerez sur un sujet à l’intersection de la modélisation séquentielle, de la personnalisation, des sciences comportementales et du jeu responsable. La thèse sera menée en partenariat avec le laboratoire IMS Bordeaux et l’ENSC Bordeaux INP. Le ou la doctorant·e sera inscrit·e à l’école doctorale Sciences Physiques et de l’Ingénieur (SPI) de l’Université de Bordeaux. La question centrale est la suivante : comment comprendre ce qu’un joueur cherche à faire à un instant donné, plutôt que seulement ce qu’il a aimé dans le passé, afin d’adapter son expérience en temps réel tout en donnant la priorité à sa protection ? YOUR RO LE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 Le sujet de thèse proposé est : « De la pertinence de l’item au pilotage de l’expérience : comprendre l’état de session d’un joueur pour personnaliser l’expérience en temps réel, sous contraintes de jeu responsable. » Le sujet sera précisé avec le ou la candidat·e retenu·e et le laboratoire académique avant le dépôt du dossier auprès de l’ANRT. Vos travaux de recherche s’articuleront autour de trois objectifs complémentaires : • Estimer un état de session latent à partir de séquences d’événements incomplètes, en tenant compte de l’incertitude et des changements de régime comportemental. • Dépasser le simple classement d’items et étudier une politique d’adaptation au niveau de l’expérience, capable de choisir entre plusieurs actions : recommander, informer, favoriser la découverte, ou ne rien pousser. • Intégrer le jeu responsable comme contrainte prioritaire de la décision, à partir de signaux précoces, incertains et évolutifs observés au cours de la session. Le travail s’appuiera sur la comparaison de deux environnements contrastés, les paris sportifs et le Casino, ainsi que sur un accès direct à des systèmes en cours de déploiement en production. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 Nous recherchons une personne curieuse et rigoureuse, qui apprécie les problèmes ouverts et souhaite relier recherche scientifique et impact concret. • Vous êtes titulaire, ou bientôt titulaire, d’un Master 2 ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur en statistiques, mathématiques appliquées, Data Science, Machine Learning, informatique, cognitique ou dans un domaine proche. • Vous êtes récemment diplômé·e ou disposez d’une à deux années d’expérience en industrie en Data Science, Machine Learning, R&D ou analyse de données, et souhaitez vous engager dans une thèse. • Vous avez une réelle appétence pour les statistiques, la modélisation et l’analyse de données comportementales. • Vous êtes intéressé·e par la cognition, les intentions, les comportements humains ou les interactions entre individus et systèmes numériques. • Vous savez formuler des hypothèses, construire un protocole expérimental et interpréter rigoureusement des résultats. • Vous êtes à l’aise avec Python et disposez de bonnes bases en SQL. • Vous communiquez clairement avec des interlocuteurs scientifiques, techniques et métier. • Vous êtes autonome, curieux·se, rigoureux·se et appréciez le travail collaboratif. Une expérience ou des connaissances en recommandation, personnalisation, modèles séquentiels ou probabilistes, états latents, quantification de l’incertitude, évaluation de systèmes adaptatifs, sciences cognitives ou jeu responsable seront appréciées. Une appétence pour le sport, le gaming ou les environnements produits est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous aurez d’abord un échange avec les Ressources Humaines, puis un entretien avec le Head of Data Science consacré à votre parcours, vos motivations et au sujet de thèse. Vous échangerez ensuite avec les encadrants académiques lors d’un entretien scientifique, avant un dernier entretien RH. items.title: Enforcement Operations Lead, Cloud Partners
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role Anthropic's Safeguards team is responsible for enforcing our policies, protecting users, and ensuring our platform is not misused. A large and growing share of Claude usage reaches customers through our cloud partners: Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. As the Enforcement Operations Lead for Multi-Cloud, you'll own how Anthropic detects, reviews, and acts on misuse across those surfaces, where the partner owns the customer relationship and often the data path. You'll build the operating model, partner agreements, and documentation that make enforcement on every cloud consistent, auditable, and fast. This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and capable of coordinating across teams and companies to break new ground and drive work to completion. This work is deeply cross-functional. You'll partner closely with our product managers, policy experts, Safeguards engineering, Legal, and the trust & safety and operations teams across our Cloud partners to maintain a consistent and safe enforcement ecosystem. Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. Key responsibilities Own the end to end enforcement lifecycle on partner surfaces, from detection and review through action, customer communication, and appeal Define enforcement paths for each partner's operating model, including how actions are requested, executed, and confirmed when the partner controls the account Manage SLAs for review, escalation, and action, and evaluate performance against them on an ongoing basis Develop and maintain SOPs and escalation guides for all enforcement workflows, ensuring consistency across clouds Establish red-teaming, Quality processes, and operationalize shared metrics Stand up paired investigations with partner threat intelligence teams, including case referrals, indicator sharing, and paging for high severity incidents Own enforcement metrics across partner surfaces and report them to Safeguards leadership, partners, and regulators Minimum qualifications Extensive experience in trust and safety operations, enforcement, threat intelligence, or a related field Have managed external partner or vendor relationships where you did not control the other side's systems or priorities Comfortable working across policy, legal, engineering, and operations teams to translate requirements into practical workflows Experience building enforcement programs from the ground up, including SLAs, escalation paths, and quality measurement Highly organized, with a track record of maintaining rigorous documentation and SOPs in fast-moving environments Clear and precise communication, both in writing and verbally, across technical and non-technical audiences, including partner executives Energized by the challenge of building scalable systems in an environment where not everything is already figured out Care deeply about the responsible deployment of AI and the role enforcement operations plays in that mission Preferred qualifications Direct trust & safety, abuse, or security operations experience at AWS, GCP, or Azure, or at a company that ships through their marketplaces Experience designing incident response or escalation processes that span more than one company Familiarity with data access controls, audit requirements, or privacy constrained review environments Experience with law enforcement referrals, regulatory reporting, or compliance programs Background in AI safety, content moderation, fraud, or abuse detection systems Comfort working with data and metrics to inform operational decisions and surface trends to leadership The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $285,000 — $330,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
